title: Agency Photographers Capture NASA Marshall Campus with Drones
description: NASA photographers used drone photography to get a bird’s eye view of NASA’s Marshall Space Flight Center in Huntsville, Alabama, in late 2024. Facilities and buildings featured in this video include: the 4200 Central Campus; Advanced Propulsion Lab; Advanced Manufacturing Building; X-Ray Calibration Facility; Historic Redstone Test Site; Huntsville Operations Support Center/Payload Operations Center; Lunar Regolith Field; 4600 Engineering Complex; Building 4619; Test Stand 4693; and NASA Marshall Rocket Garden. For more information, contact NASA Marshall’s Office of Communications at 256-544-0034.
